reviews.text: I really love these guys! I don't have to worry about landmines or unpleasant odors. They are dependable and friendly, and I'm regretful that I didn't do this sooner!
Magic Unicorn Pooper Scooper and Dog Walkers provides excellent service at a fair price. In addition they are ethical and kind.

**REVIEW HAS BEEN MODIFIED TO 3 STARS ON 9/3/2025**
They were able to transfer me to a different service company to provide poop pickup for my dog, and it has been better service.  The new company responds to emails timely, and has been very responsive.  My understanding was Magic Unicorn's owner, or person handling the email was going through personal issues, which I completely respect, however, at that point and time, it should have been transitioned to another company to manage.

Terrible service.  Never answers emails or phone calls after initially contacting you to sign agreement.  Doesn't show up as scheduled, then someone randomly shows up two times in one week.  Beware of randoms coming to your house.  This company doesn't follow rules or directions written in the description.
Magic Unicorn is a great company! My guy is reliable, does a thorough job and is always a pleasure to interact with. My dog loves him too!
Great customer service , reliable and professional! This company goes out of their way to ensure the work is done right in a timely way. I highly recommend you check this out.
Very patient and understanding folks, answered my questions & concerns. Reliable service and I will use them for future business!

Dear Melinda,

Thank you so much for the amazing 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience. Your kind words truly mean a lot to us, and we're grateful for your support. If there's anything else we can do for you, please don’t hesitate to reach out!

Thank you so much, Sally, for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We truly appreciate your feedback and are so glad to hear you’re happy with our service. It means a lot to us! If you ever need anything, we're here and ready to help. 😊🐾 …

DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY. THEY NEVER ANSWER THE PHONE AND YOU'LL BE LUCKY IF THEY RESPOND TO YOUR EMAILS IN A TIMELY MANNER. ALSO IF THEY MISS YOUR APPOINTMENT OR FORGET TO SERVICE YOUR YARD THEY'LL STILL CHARGE YOU! MOST LIKELY YOU WONT GET A REFUND EITHER! THEY ARE COMPLETELY UNPROFESSIONAL!!

They are simply the best! 🦄🐾 They always show up on time and leave my yard spotless. 🌿✨ Super friendly team and my dog loves them! 🐶💕 If you're in Dallas, I highly recommend their services — they truly make life easier! 🙌😊 …

Like someone prior said, I wish I could still give a 5 star. Initially my service was definitely 5 star (started in 2020), but management changed and service took a nose-dive (around 2024). Services were inconsistent and often missed; we were never notified; the online system is horrible and never updated. When I contacted them, my emails went unanswered and no one has ever answered the phone. I even sent them a video of their waste removal person throwing the waste into my garbage can when they are supposed to take it with them. In the end, nothing was resolved. No refunds were given. No one ever returned a single call. Beware of signing up for this service; it’s no longer a good service. They aren’t even operating at level at this point.

I wish I could still give a 5 star. Initially my service was definitely 5 star, but management changed (my regular cleaner warned me when it happened and he quit around the same time) and my service went south fast. I had multiple occasions where services were missed and I would never be notified they were going to be missed or were missed. I had to contact them each time to make sure I was not charged for a service I did not receive. Not that it mattered because I still got charged for some of those visits. I found this out later as their billing and online invoices are majorly behind even to their own admission. I was told I would be refunded, but that never actually happened. I ended up changing to a different service and continued to communicate with Magic Unicorn in an attempt to get my refund, but was told repeatedly over the course of months that they were "looking into it" I have several chains of emails back and forth with no resolution on the matter so I've pretty much given up. Buyer beware I suppose. It's too bad as I had a couple of years of great service from them.
Love using this company to help walk my pups!  Friendly and caring! Definitely would recommend 😊 …
Excellent service, thank you for your help magical unicorn, I recommend them!!!
